Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the management of Paras Defence and Space 
Technologies Limited (“PARAS”) will be meeting Analysts / Institutional Investors at Citi's 2026 India Industrials 
Access Day in Singapore on August 11 & 12, 2026, and in Hong Kong on August 13, 2026 from 9:00 a.m. onwards, 
in the form of One-on-One Meeting and group meetings..
